## Baseline and checks

- Net coretests: **66 passed, 0 failed** = 47 existing + 12 behavioural + 7 optional. The benchmark and coretests doc-test targets selected no tests.
- Core net doctests: **107 passed, 0 failed**, in groups of 81 and 26. Other groups selected no tests.
- Both baseline commands exited 0 before mutation replay and again after restoring core net source.
- Mutants: **19 completed; 19 fail their mapped test**. Eighteen yield 65 passed / 1 failed; M092 yields 64 passed / 2 failed. Each coretests command exits 1; each core doctest command exits 0 with 107 passes.
- Tidy: `./x test tidy` on the patched checkout, with network: **exit 0**, "All tidy checks succeeded" (formatting included). [Output](evidence/tidy-online.txt), [command and exit code](evidence/tidy-online.exit.txt).
- Both package patches pass `git apply --check` independently on clean copies of the four net files at the pin. Applying both reproduces the final files byte-for-byte. The test text matches the 1.99.0 package patches.

```sh
./x test library/coretests --stage 1 --no-fail-fast -- net::
./x test library/core --doc --stage 1 --no-fail-fast -- net
./x fmt --check --set build.rustfmt=<rustup-home>/toolchains/nightly-2026-06-03-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin/rustfmt
```

Test and mutant runs use `CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true` and `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1`; the tidy run used the network. The fmt check temporarily records the installed formatter version in `build/.rustfmt-stamp` so x selects Git-modified files; the prior cache state is restored afterward. The installed formatter is `rustfmt 1.9.0-nightly (d595fce010 2026-06-02)`.

## Findings

- M090 needed context adaptation: add the existing stability attribute and update the hunk position. Its added and removed mutation lines remain identical. Its successful replay fails only `socket_v6_debug_snapshot`.
- M092 also fails the added enum Debug snapshot because Debug delegates to Display.
- Eight test placements do not sit beside the existing test of the same behaviour family: M078, M084, M087, M090, M092, M093, M095 and M099. The original positions are retained.
- Gap 7 (enum `SocketAddr` Display) needs both variants; this test covers V4 only. V6 remains a coverage gap.
- Only three files change; `mod.rs` remains unchanged. Core net source is clean.
- An offline tidy run could not build (`camino v1.2.1` not cached); the later run with network passed (see Tidy above).
- JSON puts the provenance marker in its first field to preserve valid JSON.
